subject: Pilot for FinEdge — discovery recap & next steps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot for FinEdge — discovery recap & next steps

Thanks again for taking time today, Ari and Samira — appreciate the candid overview of FinEdge's ingestion pipeline and latency targets. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary (what I heard)
- Primary goal: reduce latency on personalized recommendations from ~850ms to <300ms at 95th pctl for peak traffic.
- Data constraints: PII must remain in your VPC for baseline model scoring; embeddings can run in hosted tier with encrypted transit.
- Success metric: reduction in per-recommendation compute cost by >=30% and 95th pctl latency target met for the pilot traffic slice.

What Redwood would deliver for a Q3 pilot
- 4-week pilot: dedicated model variant + prefix caching to hit latency SLO for a 10% traffic slice.
- Measurables: p95 latency baseline vs pilot, per-token cost, and error/regression checks against your eval set.
- Team involvement: 2x half-days (infra + app) for setup, 1x tech review at kickoff, weekly check-ins.

Next steps I propose
1) Confirm interest and whether FinEdge wants a technical deep-dive (30–45m) with your infra lead.
2) If yes, we’ll send a short SOW/pilot proposal and a playbook for data access options (VPC peering vs private agent).
3) Target kickoff window: late July — first week of August (if that works for your roadmap).

Attachments: redwood-discovery-notes.pdf (call notes), pilot-proposal-q3.xlsx (sketch of scope + estimated cost).

If you’d prefer I loop in Ben to coordinate procurement/process earlier, happy to do that — just say the word.

Thanks,
Jonas

Jonas — really helpful write-up, thanks. Samira and I reviewed and the approach looks sensible. Two quick notes: 

- We’re finishing a sprint for a larger infra migration, so anything that needs dedicated infra hours will be tough through mid-July.
- We’re definitely interested in the latency/cost upside, but need to prioritize which pilots make it into Q3.

Can you send over the SOW + a concise list of infra touchpoints (expected firewall rules, ports, any storage/transfer requirements)? If you can give Ben a rough expected effort (in engineer-days), that’ll help us slot this.
